text: After this you can divide use by the maximum possible energy at billed peak.
Compute peak kW times every hour in the billing period.
Illustrative calculation: A site uses 36,000 kWh in 30 days. Peak demand is 80 kW. Estimate load factor as a decimal.
30 days x 24 hours = 720 hours. Maximum possible energy is 80 x 720 = 57,600 kWh. Divide 36,000 by 57,600 = 0.625.
Load factor compares average demand with billed peak demand.
